info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Parking Reservations Permits-v4-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Permit API allows users to retrieve a list of parking permits associated with reservations. This endpoint enables efficient management and oversight of parking allocations, facilitating better resource utilization. Typical consumers include property managers, event coordinators, and municipalities looking to streamline their parking operations. By integrating this API, users can access detailed information about permits and enhancements to their reservation processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows the user to retrieve information about permits associated with reservations. It provides details necessary for understanding reservation permissions and usage.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve permit reservation details. Please ensure that all required fields are provided accurately to obtain the desired permit information.

200.description: Request completed successfully and received the available permits.
